subject.title: [Feature]: Support arbitrary workspace files in bootstrap context injection

question: Should OpenClaw accept explicitly configured custom-basename workspace files as bootstrap context, or keep bootstrap-extra-files limited to recognized workspace filenames?
rationale: This changes deterministic system-prompt context and the effective configured file-loading contract, which is a product/security boundary decision rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Approve Repaired Hook Contract
options.body: Allow custom basenames through the existing hook path once the linked PR or replacement is rebased and preserves workspace containment, size budgets, diagnostics, and session filtering.

options.title: Keep Recognized Basenames Only
options.body: Reject arbitrary workspace-file injection and keep users on AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md or specific first-class filename proposals.

options.title: Defer To Broader Context API
options.body: Keep this issue open for a future context-file API instead of expanding the current bundled hook contract now.

recommendation.title: Approve Repaired Hook Contract
recommendation.body: Allow custom basenames through the existing hook path once the linked PR or replacement is rebased and preserves workspace containment, size budgets, diagnostics, and session filtering.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily about bootstrap file trust boundaries and config contract shape, and steipete has direct history in the boundary-safe workspace/bootstrap read path.
